{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for non-numeric revenue values
non_numeric_revenue = df[~df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').str.isnumeric()]
print('Non-numeric revenue values:')
print(non_numeric_revenue)

# Check the current revenue values
print('\nSample of revenue values:')
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the cleaned values
print('\nSample of cleaned revenue:')
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print('\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99):')
print(qa_orders)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print('\nRefunded orders:')
print(refunded_orders)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

print('\nMean revenue of completed orders:')
print(mean_revenue_completed)

# Output the final result
print('\nFinal mean revenue of completed orders:')
print(mean_revenue_completed)"}
